# Fix It Aid

> Fix It Aid LLC is a licensed contractor serving the City of Chicago only (no suburbs). Services: roofing (repair, flat roofs, replacement, yearly Roof Care Plan), mold inspection and removal, water damage restoration and flooded basement cleanup, and HVAC (furnace, boiler and AC repair, installation). Illinois roofing licence 104.021107. City of Chicago general contractor licence TGC144939. Phone: (773) 987-1693.

Fix It Aid gives a written price before any work starts and does not promise to handle insurance claims (Illinois law limits what a contractor can do there). Fix It Aid does not work outside the City of Chicago.

## Roofing

- [Chicago Roofing Company](https://fixitaid.com/roofing-chicago): Roof repair, flat roofs and replacement across Chicago. Illinois licensed roofer 104.021107.
- [Free Roof Check](https://fixitaid.com/free-roof-check): A free roof inspection with photos, no cost, no obligation.
- [Roof Repair in Chicago](https://fixitaid.com/roof-repair-chicago): Leak repair, storm damage, flashing, shingles.
- [Flat Roof Repair in Chicago](https://fixitaid.com/flat-roof-repair-chicago): TPO, EPDM rubber and modified bitumen repair for 2-flats, 3-flats and garages.
- [Roof Replacement in Chicago](https://fixitaid.com/roof-replacement-chicago): Full tear-off and new roof, shingle or flat, when repair no longer makes sense.
- [Roof Care Plan](https://fixitaid.com/roof-care-plan): Yearly roof inspection and minor repairs for one set price.

## Mold and water damage

- [Mold Inspection and Testing in Chicago](https://fixitaid.com/mold-inspection-chicago): Air and surface testing, moisture readings, written lab report.
- [Mold Removal in Chicago](https://fixitaid.com/mold-removal-chicago): Contained removal, source repair and clearance testing.
- [Water Damage Restoration in Chicago](https://fixitaid.com/water-damage-restoration-chicago): Water extraction, structural drying, mold check and rebuild.
- [Flooded Basement Cleanup in Chicago](https://fixitaid.com/flooded-basement-cleanup-chicago): Pump-out, disinfection and drying for storm flooding and sewer backup.

## Heating and cooling (HVAC)

- [Heating and Cooling in Chicago](https://fixitaid.com/hvac-chicago): Furnace, boiler and AC repair, tune-ups and installs.
- [Furnace and Boiler Repair in Chicago](https://fixitaid.com/furnace-repair-chicago): Repair for furnaces and steam or hot water boilers, all makes.
- [AC Repair in Chicago](https://fixitaid.com/ac-repair-chicago): Central air and ductless mini split repair.
- [Furnace and AC Installation in Chicago](https://fixitaid.com/hvac-installation-chicago): New systems sized to the home, written price.
